about_the_game:
Winter Hungers is the first case in Entities Declassified, a narrative-driven psychological-horror anthology where every episode lets you relive a chilling short story that was meant to stay buried.

The footage stayed hidden for decades.
In February 1997 the NightFinders crew headed north to Kenora District’s Lake of the Woods region to film the pilot for a cryptid themed paranormal show. The tapes and the truth of that tragic night were locked away, but now the case is finally DECLASSIFIED.

Entities Declassified: Winter Hungers lets you step into that night. Relive the unaired episode as it unfolds around you. Trek through the drifting snow to investigate an abandoned sawmill and logging cabins as NightFinders cameraman Sam Jacobs, and piece together why the shoot went dark.

Gameplay falls within the first-person walking simulator genre, with a rich conversational narrative and exploration. 

  • Highly detailed and atmospheric environments to explore.

  • Dynamic dialogue with choices that shape the narrative and build relationships.

  • Rich folklore inspired story that unfolds through dialogue and discovered notes.

  • Multiple endings based on your conversational choices and the clues you uncover.

Can you unravel the mystery before winter hungers again?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains intense horror themes, moderate jump scares, and infrequent scenes of violence and gore, including bloodstained environments, human / animal remains, and graphic sound effects. The experience is designed to create sustained psychological tension and fear. No sexual content, self-harm, or drug use is depicted.

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit required)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11600 / Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX 590
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64 bit required)

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM

short_description: An amateur TV crew disappeared during a 1997 shoot in Ontario’s deep woods. Step into that frostbitten night in the chilling first case in Entities Declassified, untangle their fate, and learn what silenced the crew.
